Hong Kong Good Take
The 60-metre-tall Hong Kong Observation Wheel on the Central Harbour Promenade is both a dazzling Victoria Harbour landmark and a popular filming location for both Chinese and foreign films and television series. In the mainland Chinese series
Our Generation
(2025), the male and female protagonists open up to each other under the massive Ferris wheel. Jiang Qiao-xi reveals his painfully lonely childhood, while Lin Ying-tao’s distant shouts soothe his wounds. The Ferris wheel also blends into the background of Victoria Harbour’s nightscape in
Hello, Love, Goodbye
(2019), witnessing the encounter of the male and female leads while adrift in a foreign land. Under the glow of the Ferris wheel, they find solace in each other, adding a touch of romance to this landmark.
More Filming Locations
Breathtaking views of Hong Kong’s skyline
Take to the skies for a captivating aerial experience amidst the dazzling Hong Kong skyline. Standing at 60 metres tall with 42 individual gondolas, this iconic attraction is a prominent fixture of the cityscape and a must-do when visiting.
Affordable tickets for a comfortable ride
For an affordable ticket, you’ll be offered breathtaking views across Hong Kong Island, Victoria Harbour and beyond, all from the air-conditioned comfort of your gondola.
The ride lasts around 15 to 20 minutes and includes two to three rotations of the wheel, providing ample opportunity to take in the scenery. Take in the panorama of Hong Kong’s best landmarks, the towering skyscrapers nearby, the historic Star Ferry Pier and the glittering lights of Kowloon.
Discover harbourfront & AIA Vitality Park
Conveniently located in the heart of the Central Harbourfront, the Hong Kong Observation Wheel is surrounded by the AIA Vitality Park, which presents a variety of cultural happenings throughout the year.
These include street art from local artists, along with a variety of fun quirky photo installations. In addition to a classic hand-painted carousel, you’ll find the AIA Vitality Hub and AIA Vitality Park Event Space.
The AIA Vitality Hub is a unique health and wellness space where you can participate in a variety of community events that promote active, healthy lifestyles for free. Depending on the time of year, the Event Space hosts everything from outdoor cinema screenings to local craft markets.
